chapterInfo.content:
26
Paulo yi n’ano wɔ Agripa anim
1Na Agripa ka kyerɛɛ Paulo sɛ: Wɔama wo kwan sɛ ka w’asɛm. Ɛnna Paulo tenee ne nsa yii ano sɛ: 2Mebu no sɛ ɛyɛ akwannya ma me sɛ merebɛyi m’ano nnɛ wɔ wo Ɔhene Agripa anim, wɔ nnoɔma a Yudafoɔ de toto m’ano nyinaa ho, 3ne titire no, wonim amanneɛ nyinaa ne akyinnyesɛm a ɛwɔ Yudafoɔ mu; enti mesrɛ wo sɛ tɔ wo bo ase tie me.
4M’asetena a ɛfiri me mmɔfraase no deɛ, sɛdeɛ ɛfirii aseɛ na ɛteɛ me manfoɔ mu wɔ Yerusalem no, Yudafoɔ nyinaa nim. 5#Aso 23.6; Flp 3.5 Na wɔnim me firi mfitiaseɛ dada, nso sɛ wɔpɛ sɛ wɔdi ɛho adanseɛ a, wɔnim me sɛ mefraa fekuo a wɔdi yɛn som so pɛpɛɛpɛ no mu, mebɔɔ me bra sɛ Farisini. 6#Aso 28.20 Na afei megyina ha, na wɔrebu me atɛn Nyankopɔn bɔ a ɔhyɛɛ yɛn agyanom no ho anidasoɔ nti. 7#Aso 24.15 Ɛno ara na yɛn mmusuakuo dummienu no de awia ne anadwo som, a emu yɛ den, ma wɔn ani da so sɛ wɔbɛnya. Ɔhene, saa anidasoɔ yi nti na Yudafoɔ toto m’ano yi. 8Adɛn nti na mobu yei asɛm a wɔnnye nnie sɛ Onyankopɔn nyane awufoɔ?
9Ɛwɔ mu sɛ ɛyɛɛ me ara nso sɛ, ɛsɛ me sɛ meyɛ nnoɔma pii metia Yesu Nasareni no din; 10ɛno nso na meyɛɛ no Yerusalem, na menyaa asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ nkyɛn tumi no, mede ahotefoɔ bebree meguu afiase. Na wɔrekum wɔn a, mede m’ano meto mu bi. 11Na metaa metwee wɔn aso hyia adan nyinaa mu, na mehyɛɛ wɔn maa wɔkaa abususɛm, na m’ani beree wɔn so papaapa nti, metaa wɔn kɔduruu ananafoɔ nkuro so.
Paulo adwensakyera ho asɛm
12Ɛno mu na menam sɛ merekɔ Damasko, na asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ ama me tumi ne ɛho kwan. 13Na awigyina, ɔhene, ɛkwan so no, mehunuu hann bi a ɛkyɛne owia hran sɛ ɛfiri soro abɛtwa me ne wɔn a wɔne me nam no ho ahyia. 14Na yɛn nyinaa hwehwee aseɛ no, metee nne bi a ɛkasa kyerɛɛ me Hebri kasa mu sɛ: Saulo, Saulo, adɛn nti na wotaa me? Ɛyɛ den ma wo sɛ wobɛto ɔkafoɔ poma ano dadeɛ kotie. 15Na mese: Ɛyɛ wo hwan a, Awura? Na Awurade kaa sɛ: Ɛyɛ me Yesu a wotaa no no. 16Na sɔre gyina wo nan so; na yei nti na meyii me ho mekyerɛɛ woɔ, sɛ mɛyi wo mayɛ wo nnoɔma a woahu me wɔ mu ne deɛ merebɛyi me ho makyerɛ wo wɔ mu no ho somfoɔ ne danseni. 17Na mɛgye wo mafiri ɔman no ne amanaman a meresoma wo wɔn nkyɛn no nsam. 18#Aso 20.32 Na woabue wɔn ani, na wɔadane afiri sum mu aba hann mu, na wɔafiri Satan tumi ase aba Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na wɔanya bɔne fakyɛ ne agyapadeɛ, wɔn a wɔde gyeɛ a wɔgye me die no ate wɔn ho no mu.
19 # Gal 1.16 Enti, Ɔhene Agripa, manyɛ ɔsoro adeɛ a wɔyi kyerɛɛ me no ho asoɔden, 20na meka mekyerɛɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ Damasko kane, ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Yerusalem ne Yudea asase nyinaa so, ne amanaman no, sɛ wɔnsakyera wɔn adwene, na wɔnnane mmra Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na wɔnyɛ nnwuma a ɛsɛ adwensakyera.
21 # Aso 21.30-31 Yei nti na Yudafoɔ bɛkyeree me asɔrefie hwehwɛɛ sɛ wɔku me. 22#Luka 24.44-47 Na ɛnam sɛ Onyankopɔn di m’akyire nti, na megyina hɔ de abɛduru nnɛ yi, na medi nnipa nketewa ne akɛseɛ adanseɛ, na menka biribiara sɛ deɛ adiyifoɔ ne Mose kaa sɛ ɛbɛba no: 23#1 Ko 15.20 Sɛ Kristo no bɛhunu amane, na wadi awufoɔ sɔreɛ mu kan ama wɔaka hann ho asɛm akyerɛ ɔman no ne amanaman mufoɔ no.
Paulo tu Agripa fo sɛ ɔnnye nni
24Na ɔyii n’ano saa no, Festo de nne kɛseɛ kaa sɛ: Paulo, woabɔ dam, nwomanim bebrebe abɔ wo dam. 25Na ɔse: Memmɔɔ dam, Onimuonyamfoɔ Festo, na meka nokorɛ ne anidahɔ nsɛm. 26#Yoh 18.20 Na ɔhene a mede nnam meka mekyerɛ no yi nim nsɛm yi mu; na megye medi sɛ yeinom biara nhuntaa no, ɛfiri sɛ wɔanyɛ yei kokoa mu. 27Ɔhene Agripa, wogye adiyifoɔ di anaa? Menim sɛ wogye di.
28Na Agripa ka kyerɛɛ Paulo sɛ: Wopɛ sɛ wode ɛberɛ kakraa bi ma me dane bɛyɛ Okristoni anaa? 29Na Paulo se: Anka mepɛ Nyankopɔn fam sɛ, kakraa bi oo, bebree oo, ɛnyɛ wo nko, na mmom wɔn a wɔretie me nnɛ yi nyinaa nso nyɛ sɛ me ara, gye mpokyerɛ yi nko mu.
30Na ɔhene ne amrado ne Berenike ne wɔn a wɔne wɔn te hɔ no sɔreeɛ, 31na wɔkɔɔ nkyɛn baabi no, wɔsesee wɔn ho sɛ: Onipa yi nyɛɛ biribi a ɛsɛ wuo anaa ɛkyerɛ. 32#Aso 25.11 Na Agripa ka kyerɛɛ Festo sɛ: Sɛ onipa yi amfa n’asɛm ankɔdane Kaesare a, anka wɔbɛtumi agyaa no.

Ɛno mu na menam sɛ merekɔ Damasko, na asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ ama me tumi ne ɛho kwan. Na Awurade kaa sɛ: Ɛyɛ me Yesu a wotaa no no. app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
